name: scorly
description: Scorly - SEO Score & OG Preview browser extension

scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.store-assets:chrome: node scripts/capture-popup.js chrome && node scripts/compose-slides.js chrome
scripts.store-assets:firefox: node scripts/capture-popup.js firefox && node scripts/compose-slides.js firefox
scripts.store-assets: npm run store-assets:chrome && npm run store-assets:firefox
